Found it — `worker\src\index.ts`, the `cors()` middleware's `origin` callback (lines ~20-30).

**Currently allowed origins:**
- `http://localhost:4200` (local dev)
- any subdomain of `*.pages.dev`
- any subdomain of `*.workers.dev`

**Where to add a custom domain:** edit the `origin` callback in `worker\src\index.ts`, inside the `if (...)` condition, e.g.:

```js
origin === 'http://localhost:4200' ||
origin.endsWith('.pages.dev') ||
origin.endsWith('.workers.dev') ||
origin === 'https://your-custom-domain.com'   // add this line
```

For a wildcard subdomain (e.g. any `*.yourdomain.com`), add `origin.endsWith('.yourdomain.com')` similarly. No other config files define CORS allowlists.
